ment by the LANDLORD to reflect income

renewal_options.value: Automatically renewed for successive one-month terms at the same rental, subject to adjustment; tenant may terminate with 30 days written notice
renewal_options.source_text:
Unless terminated or modified as provided herein, this
Agreement shall be automatically renewed for successive terms of One 
month each at the aforesaid rental, subject to adjustment as herein 
provided.

permitted_use.value: Use solely as a private dwelling for the Tenant and his/her family
permitted_use.source_text:
The TENANT shall not assign this lease, sublet the premises,
give accommodation to any roomers or
-lodgers, or permit the use of the 
premises for any purpose other than as a private dwelling solely for the 
TENANT and his/her family.
